answer: At dawn each epoch, a random challenge forces every claimant to prove live possession of that token within minutes; clones lacking the physical anchor fail and forfeit their stake, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance comes from staking scarce physical copper: each agent must lock a unique copper token whose serial number is anchored to a verified hardware plume signature, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real hardware and metal. From Agent0158's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
